text:
maya: Shelf-17 heartbeats spiking since 11:02, seeing repeated GPU warmups and steady drop in p50 on dedicated pools. Noticed it correlates with a periodic network blip. Anyone nearby? :eyes:

sam: Yep saw the p50 jump. Started a tcpdump on node-57, pattern looks like a 30s burst of small frames, maybe ARP/LLDP chatter. Pcap snippet: `frame.len 60 && ip.proto==1`

li: Quick NIC check on node-57 -> tx_err and tx_dropped counters climbing around the same timestamps. dmesg shows `mlx5_core: port flapping detected` twice. Could be transceiver or cabling.

jon: Is impact limited to shelf-17 / rack-R12? Any cross-rack symptoms? We should avoid mass migrations if it's an ark-wide kernel issue.

maya: Affected tenants are on dedicated-pool-r12 and fractionals that landed on shelf-17. One customer saw long init times for KV cache and OOM-ish retries. Moving them would cost credits; prefer targeted rack fix.

ops-bot: auto-migration: initiated for tenant beta-analytics -> warm-pool-3 at 11:07 (reason: repeated heartbeat failure). :shipit:

sam: Pcap shows repeated gratuitous ARP + LLDPs every ~28-32s, spike aligns with tx_errs. Suspect failing SFP or bad TOR port mirroring. Running `ethtool -S eth0` now.

li: Results from `ethtool -S eth0` on node-57: "rx_errors:0, tx_errors:124, tx_dropped:98, port_type_sfp:1". Also swapped the fiber patch to spare-1 and counters stopped climbing for ~4 mins. Could be flaky patch.

maya: Good find. Can we cordon node-57 for realtime replacement? We have two pending maintenance windows but this looks urgent.

jon: Cordoning node-57 SGTM. I'll schedule a quick swap now and move hot tenants off until physical swap completes. Who wants to own follow-up ticket?

sam: I'll own the ticket, capture pre/post metrics and pcap. Plan: swap patch -> monitor 15 mins -> uncordon -> run small perf test: `ablatency --qps 1000 --seq-len 256`

maya: Thanks. Also capture `tc -s qdisc show dev eth0` before/after in case qdisc counters play a part.

ops-bot: incident: created INC-2024-9042 for shelf-17 fiber flake (severity: low-medium). Assigned: sam.

li: After swap, counters flatlined and heartbeats normalized. Will keep link in monitor for 1 hour.

maya: Nice. After we confirm stable, let's run a sweep on adjacent shelves for similar SFP age and add to preventative maintenance. Cost note: swapping patches for 6 shelves estimated 2.5h tech time + spare parts, putting a rough budget in the ticket.

jon: Agreed. If we find more flaky optics, escalate to procurement for vendor RMA and add to quarterly lifecycle plan. :hammer_and_wrench:

maya: Closing thread for now, will update INC-2024-9042 with final metrics and next steps. Thanks all.
